verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents that a full general ledger and financial statements can be exported in cash/accrual basis as Excel, CSV, and PDF (puzzle-docs-26/37), and markets an 'Embedded Accounting' API for data access (puzzle-docs-1/21/32), but there is no evidence of a documented API endpoint specifically for pulling the GL or trial balance, and probes found no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (puzzle-probe-3) or API docs page (puzzle-probe-2). Missing for 10: a documented API reference for GL/trial balance retrieval, explicit trial balance API support, and confirmation of open-format API responses (vs. UI export only).
